title: Stop the user API leaking password hashes

task.text: `UserApi.show` and `list` return `User` entities, and `Json.fields` serializes every field, so each response carries the `passwordHash`.
Fix it with a response DTO. `User`, `Json` and `register`'s return value must not change.

items: Add `record UserSummary(long id, String displayName, boolean admin)`; `displayName` is `firstName lastName`.
`show(long)` returns a `UserSummary` and `list()` a `List<UserSummary>`; unknown ids still throw `IllegalArgumentException`.
`RegisterRequest` validates itself: a null email or one without `@` throws `IllegalArgumentException` from its constructor.
The entity must not know how it is presented.

checks.title: show sends no hash, email or roles
show sends exactly id, displayName and admin
A bad email is refused by the request
The API returns DTOs, not User
The DTO is immutable and holds no entity
User does not build the response

hints.text: Whatever type you return is your public contract. A `User` has more fields than clients should ever see, so return a smaller type made for the wire.
Add a `UserSummary` record with only the three fields, and a mapping from `User` to it. `show` and `list` map before returning. Give `RegisterRequest` a compact constructor that checks the email.
